printed_to_pdf_page_rule: PDF page floor((printed page + 6) / 2); even printed page left, odd right. Actual page bounds used; scan widths vary.
row_scope: 34 explicit Delta nonstop rows, both directions on eight airport pairs. Through and connecting totals excluded; PDX and SRQ added.
operator_identification: All accepted flight numbers are below the Delta Connection ranges.
frequency_legend: D encodes blank/daily; all accepted rows are daily. Star denotes off-peak fare, not rollover.

dated_footnotes_on_selected_rows.decision_note: Explicit stops=0 row, visually reviewed. Blank frequency means daily. Footnote 4 starts 12 February, before the import period. Each independently timed leg is imported once; through and connecting rows are excluded.

special_cases.Midnight: SAN–PHX 504 22:25–00:21 and HNL–DFW 16 19:10–06:03 arrive on the next local calendar date.
special_cases.Earlier local arrival: PHX–SAN 259 20:35–20:30 lasts 55 minutes, and 487 23:45–23:40 also lasts 55 minutes. Both use the same local arrival date.
special_cases.Short segments: SAN–ONT rows repeat under the aggregate Los Angeles heading on p.213 and standalone Ontario on p.214. Imported only once.
special_cases.Portland: PDX in Oregon, not PWM in Maine. Portland–Atlanta and Portland–Dallas through rows have a stop; only separately timed PDX–SLC/SEA rows create new legs.
special_cases.Sarasota: International name added in 1992; not backdated to 1986. Current coordinates are approximate airfield markers, not historical terminal locations.
special_cases.Source precision: SLC–PDX 565 departs 11:28. SRQ–ATL 560 arrives 22:13. HNL–DFW is flight 16, not 18.
special_cases.Footnotes: ATL–SRQ 1119 and SRQ–ATL 396 start 12 February; definitions reviewed on pp.17 and 219.
special_cases.Aircraft: Same-number adjacent legs and equipment icons do not establish an individual aircraft or actual flight path.
